title: Overview
content: The on-campus Wellness Centre is a 20-bed integrated medical facility serving students, faculty, staff and visitors. It provides round-the-clock medical facilities, nurse attendants and ambulance service. A qualified general physician is available during the day and on-call at night.

title: Counselling
content: The counselling centre helpline numbers listed by Bennett University are 0120-7199500 and 9289109580.

title: Medical support
content: Bennett University states that the Wellness Centre provides round-the-clock medical facilities and has experienced male and female nurse attendants.

title: Ambulance
content: Bennett University states that ambulance service is available through the on-campus Wellness Centre.

title: General physician
content: A qualified general physician is available during the day and on-call at night, according to Bennett University's current Wellness Centre page.

title: Campus medical facility
content: Bennett University's admission FAQ states that the campus has a Health and Wellness Centre staffed by a dedicated doctor and healthcare professionals, with 24/7 ambulance availability for medical emergencies.

title: Hospital tie-ups
content: Bennett University's admission FAQ states that the university has formal tie-ups with Kailash Hospital, Greater Noida, and Yatharth hospitals in Greater Noida and Noida.
